Hi, 
the crucial bit seems to be
Caused by: java.io.IOException: Cannot run program "Rscript": java.io.IOException: error=2, No such file or directory

which points to a missing or incomplete R installation on one of the nodes. Rscript is a program distributed with R and it needs to be on the executable search path (PATH environment variable). 


Antonio
